newsitem.title: UK: Halifax has no plans to up mortgage rate.
newsitem.headline: Halifax has no plans to up mortgage rate.

text.p: Britain's largest mortgage lender the Halifax Building Society said on Tuesday it had no plans to increase its mortgage rate following an announcement by the Nationwide Building Society that it was increasing its variable rate to 6.74 percent from 6.49 percent.
"We have no plans to increase it following this announcment today," a Halifax spokesman told Reuters. The Halifax's standard variable mortgage rate currently stands at 6.99 percent.
The spokesman said the Halifax would review its position after the UK budget.
"We will review things after the budget," he said.
